moonrise.jpg.description: Moonrise, Hernandez, New Mexico, one of Ansel Adams' most famous photos. Photographed on November 1, 1941, 4:49:20 p.m. local time, as subsequently determined through independent analysis by amateur astronomer Dennis di Cicco.
